items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Levy was a man that had Eddie Johnson up at a place that later on became the Cotton Club

ctx.x: Yeah. And I had the makings of a better band than I had. Had we been able to go. But in those days, there was no go because if you didn't have a radio network in your place, it wasn't going. A man named Levy, he tried to open a place in Long Island and have us there, but somehow he couldn't get the liquor license or something. Anyhow, Levy was a man that had Eddie Johnson up at a place that later on became the Cotton Club, you know?
Oh, right. So what did you do? Did you get any jobs?
